heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 31a to 31h of this title:

tree.heading: Advisory committee
tree.text: The term “advisory committee” means the advisory committee established under section 31d of this title.

tree.heading: Association
tree.text: The term “Association” means the Association of American State Geologists.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the United States Geological Survey.

tree.heading: Education component
tree.text: The term “education component” means the education component of the geologic mapping program described in section 31c(d)(3) of this title.

tree.heading: Federal component
tree.text: The term “Federal component” means the Federal component of the geologic mapping program described in section 31c(d)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Geologic mapping program
tree.text: The term “geologic mapping program” means the National Cooperative Geologic Mapping Program established by section 31c(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” includes the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, Guam, and the Virgin Islands.

tree.heading: State component
tree.text: The term “State component” means the State component of the geologic mapping program described in section 31c(d)(2) of this title.

tree.heading: Survey
tree.text: The term “Survey” means the United States Geological Survey.

notes.text: References in TextSections 31a to 31h of this title, referred to in text, was in the original “this Act”, meaning Pub. L. 102–285, known as the National Geologic Mapping Act of 1992, which is classified principally to sections 31a to 31h of this title. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 31a of this title and Tables.
